title: Get the tests in a form you can run
statement: As a developer, I can get a release's chosen tests in a form my test runner accepts, so I, or an agent, can run exactly those tests straight away.
overview: This fills a real gap: `review test-plan` has a `commands` list, but it only returns commands from deprecated run records. This Saga has none, so every test it selected across three merged reviews reported `missing_command`. A line location suits Playwright and similar runners; a runner that selects by name can start from the JSON.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release tests --format json` gives each test's case, path and lines as data.
`--format locations` prints one `path:line` per test, with lines resolved at the range's end.
`--format command` fills in the Saga's command template with those locations.
In this repository, running the printed command makes Playwright run the selected tests and no others.
Asking for a command with no template is refused and names the command that sets one.
